groups.description: Optional logical groups. Each group takes its own floors; the groups run from the lowest floor up in rank order.

role.description: Logical assignment role confirmed from documents. It does not imply a spawn parent or a run status.

archived.description: A session that is retired or explicitly archived. It does not change the run status.

name.description: Shown on the floor badge in front of the team name.

rank.description: A smaller rank is a more important group and takes the lower floors (1F first). Groups of equal rank keep the order they are listed in. Sessions of no group sit above all groups.

members.description: Session IDs that belong to the group. A listed member wins over a name pattern.

match.description: Session name patterns (* any run of characters, ? one character, case ignored), matched against the session name and its aliases, so a new session joins the group by name.

exclude.description: Optional. Sessions left out of the viewer altogether (the server never sends them): not in the sessions, floors, counts or relations, whatever the activity filter says, and the sub-agents they spawned go with them. Without it nothing is left out.

archived.description: true leaves out the sessions marked `archived: true` in this file, also when their observed name differs from the name in the file.

match.description: Session name patterns (* any run of characters, ? one character, case ignored), matched against the session's current name only, not its aliases. A session that a supplement lists without `archived: true` is never left out by a pattern.

unlisted.description: true also leaves out every observed session of the projects named by `project` that no supplement file lists in `sessions`, unless a listed session spawned it (a sub-agent of a listed session stays). Its name or a group pattern never spares it.

project.description: Project pattern (* any run of characters, ? one character, case ignored; * for every project) that `unlisted` is limited to. Compared with the session's project: the supplement's `project`, else the folder name of its working directory.

type.description: management is a logical assignment from a coordinator → assigned session and is distinct from a native spawn.
